description: This program elective introduces agent-based architectures for system engineering tasks under constrained environments, arriving at consensus among resource-constrained agents, and control under communication constraints with applications to engineering systems.

syllabus.title: Introduction to Multi-Agent Systems
syllabus.body: Introduction to multi-agent systems, mathematical models of agent dynamics, basics of cooperative control and consensus issues, fundamentals of graph theory, graph-based models of distributed control systems.

syllabus.title: Consensus and Formation Control
syllabus.body: Optimization issues and consensus problems in multi-agent systems, cooperative control, leader-follower architecture, formation control in multi-agent systems, position, displacement and distance based formation control.

syllabus.title: Control under Communication Constraints
syllabus.body: Control under communication constraints, introduction to modeling of communication channels, modeling of network delays, stability assessment under network delays.

syllabus.title: Advanced Control Issues
syllabus.body: Advanced control issues in linear multi-agent systems, event triggered control of multi-agent systems, applications to coordinated control of networked power systems, case studies and simulations.

outcomes: Understand and apply the background mathematical theory of matrices and graph theory to describe multi-agent systems.
Recognize the need for distributed systems in place of centralized systems and distributed computational intelligence.
Formulate consensus problems and their solutions with application to simple problems.
Apply output and observer based consensus protocols on multi-agent systems and extend robust control results to such systems.
textbooks: Magdi H. Mahmoud, Multiagent Systems: Introduction and Coordination Control, CRC Press, 2020.
Zhongkui Li and Zhisheng Duan, Cooperative Control of Multi-Agent Systems: A Consensus Region Approach, CRC Press, 2015.
Frank L. Lewis, Hongwei Zhang, Kristian Hengster-Movric and Abhijit Das, Cooperative Control of Multi-Agent Systems: Optimal and Adaptive Design Approaches, Springer-Verlag, 2014.
referenceBooks: Cheng-Lin Liu and Fei Liu, Consensus Problem of Delayed Linear Multi-Agent Systems: Analysis and Design, Springer Verlag, 2017.
